original_value: General Information : Brand : Samsung Product Series : 860 Series Product Model : MZ-76P256E Product Type : Solid State Drive Key Features : Capacity : 256 GB Interface : Sata-6gbps Drive Dimensions : 2.5 Inch Encryption Algorithm : 256-Bit Aes Nand Flash Memory Type : 3d Multi-Level Cell (Mlc) Compliant Standards : Wwn, Ieee 1667 Buffer Size : 512 Mb Features : Trim Support, Sleep Mode, 3d V-Nand Technology, Auto Garbage Collection Algorithm, Edrive, Samsung Mjx Controller, Low Power Ddr4 Sdram Cache, S.M.A.R.T., 256-Bit Aes, Ieee 1667 Performance : Drive Transfer Rate : 600 Mbps (External) Internal Data Rate : 560 Mbps (Read) / 530 Mbps (Write) Maximum 4kb Random Write : 90000 Iops Maximum 4kb Random Read : 100000 Iops

result.paraphrase: Samsung 860 Series solid state drive, model MZ-76P256E, with 256 GB capacity and a SATA-6Gbps interface in a 2.5-inch form factor. It uses 3D MLC NAND flash and 256-bit AES encryption, and complies with WWN and IEEE 1667 standards. Includes a 512 MB buffer plus TRIM support, Sleep Mode, 3D V-NAND technology, auto garbage collection, eDrive, Samsung MJX controller, low-power DDR4 SDRAM cache, S.M.A.R.T., 256-bit AES, and IEEE 1667. Performance specs list 600 Mbps external transfer rate, 560 Mbps read and 530 Mbps write internal data rates, 100000 IOPS maximum 4KB random read, and 90000 IOPS maximum 4KB random write.
